issues.problem: The built-in generator returned RGB with a baked checkerboard instead of genuine alpha.
issues.promptPatch: Return actual transparent pixels outside the card. Do not visualize transparency with any checkerboard. Output RGBA PNG and keep every canvas-edge pixel fully transparent.

issues.problem: Decorative moon/star symbols conflict with the no-icons constraint and may be too prominent for a stretch-safe frame.
issues.promptPatch: Remove all moon and star symbols. Keep only abstract restrained corner filigree; leave the long edge middles plain and repeatable.

issues.problem: The offline mockup replaces the defective image region but does not reconstruct the original input and button layers, so control fit cannot be accepted from these composites.
issues.promptPatch: No image-generation patch. If the owner selects this direction, validate controls in the isolated runtime-preview step before proposing any formal replacement.

decision: The raw candidate is not eligible. The normalized derivative may be reviewed only as a composition experiment; it must not enter runtime or formal approval.
nextRoundPromptPatch: actual RGBA transparency, all canvas-edge pixels alpha 0
no moon, stars, hearts, icons, glyphs, letters or digits
quieter rose-gold border and larger untextured center
